$Comment: The main daily board: two ungated training contracts plus a weighted easy, normal and hard ladder, all turning over at midnight UTC. Currencies is the balance strip in the header - life essence is listed beside bounty tokens because a daily contract asks the player to spend essence, so both balances have to be visible while they choose. AcceptRequires gates a whole band rather than one contract, so a newcomer still SEES the hard warrant and can see what to work towards.
